title: Body of jeep owner swept away by flood in Batangas found
summary: Search and rescue teams recovered on Monday morning the body of a 44-year-old man who was aboard and owned the jeepney swept away by floodwaters while crossing a spillway along the Paninsingin River…

blocks.text: Search and rescue teams recovered on Monday morning the body of a 44-year-old man who was aboard and owned the jeepney swept away by floodwaters while crossing a spillway along the Paninsingin River in Barangay Colongan, Rosario, Batangas, on Saturday afternoon.
